field_overrides.description: Mapping between the tables that store append-only data and the deduplicated tables, e.g. rawTable1:[dedupeSchema.]dedupeTable1,rawTable2:[dedupeSchema.]dedupeTable2,etc. The dedupeTable in mapping will be used for QA scripts. If dedupeSchema is not specified, the deduplicated table will be created in the same schema as the raw table.
Per topic configuration in JSON format
